problem_statement: Issue #17 requests a synthetic-only Dallas appraisal parser foundation with typed adapter-layer records, observed-header parsing, vendor-neutral translation, deterministic failures, tests, and documentation. [source_id: ca0df171cabe5f246f2a4fe5] Accepted design establishes `ACCOUNT_NUM` as a 17-character zero-padded identifier distinct from `GIS_PARCEL_ID`, uses `(ACCOUNT_NUM, APPRAISAL_YR)` as the Dallas source row key, and leaves `TOT_VAL` without approved canonical value semantics. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] No county adapter is currently production-ready. [source_id: 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827] The supplied authoritative context does not define the exact observed headers, layout fingerprints, parser grammar, diagnostic contract, provenance envelope, or vendor-neutral output record needed for safe implementation; issue prose is evidence rather than authority. [source_id: d253d5455b500dc5f5a9bca6]
desired_outcome: Create an issue-linked draft OpenSpec delta that modifies the existing `dallas-cad-source-contract` capability and records the decisions required for a deterministic, adapter-local Dallas parser using only synthetic fixtures. [source_id: fc02f32a50f16c9ec430bd1b] The trusted materializer may render only the five proposed planning artifacts; no implementation or production files are proposed. [source_id: d253d5455b500dc5f5a9bca6] Implementation remains ineligible until every blocking decision is resolved, the change validates, and an authorized maintainer merges the planning pull request. [source_id: 2e0a24560feb74d4881dab53]
assumptions: The change modifies the existing `dallas-cad-source-contract` capability rather than introducing a shared county parser, PACS abstraction, or Dallas-shaped domain model. [source_id: fc02f32a50f16c9ec430bd1b] [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]

Dallas field names, layouts, source records, and parser diagnostics remain within `property_tax_adapters`; application and domain contracts remain vendor-neutral and preserve `dags/services -> adapters -> application -> domain`. [source_id: c83b55e968e3981f0030935d] [source_id: 76e21fb4c68b6f87724edaac] [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]

affected_capabilities: `dallas-cad-source-contract` (modified): add a parser-foundation delta covering approved Dallas source records, observed-header binding, fail-closed layout validation, provenance, source extras, vendor-neutral translation boundaries, synthetic fixtures, deterministic diagnostics, and unresolved-value handling. Shared acquisition, publication, and other county contracts remain unchanged. [source_id: fc02f32a50f16c9ec430bd1b] [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] [source_id: ca0df171cabe5f246f2a4fe5]

acceptance_criteria: AC6: `ACCOUNT_NUM` remains a 17-character zero-padded string, `GIS_PARCEL_ID` remains distinct, `APPRAISAL_YR` and approved provenance are retained, and `TOT_VAL` is never assigned an unapproved canonical meaning. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]

AC7: Duplicate parent rows at `(ACCOUNT_NUM, APPRAISAL_YR)` are rejected deterministically; child-member canonical publication remains excluded until natural child keys and roll-up rules are approved. [source_id: ca0df171cabe5f246f2a4fe5] [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812]
risks: Mapping `TOT_VAL` or jurisdiction-specific values to market, appraised, assessed, taxable, bill, payment, delinquency, penalty, or interest concepts would fabricate semantics. Mitigation: preserve unresolved values as source-native facts. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] [source_id: b34baeeecb2d6f95937ce5a1]

Fixtures or diagnostics could accidentally contain county source artifacts or protected identity data. Mitigation: author synthetic values independently, keep diagnostics schema-oriented, and enforce artifact and secret checks. [source_id: 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0] [source_id: 1f68cbd53a026079a9b30f8d] [source_id: 12eb90de41980a9b5226022f]

No credentials, county archives, databases, spatial files, tabular source extracts, or production records may be committed; repository secret and artifact gates remain mandatory. [source_id: 12eb90de41980a9b5226022f] [source_id: 1f68cbd53a026079a9b30f8d]
migration_compatibility_concerns: Runtime compatibility: preserve `dags/services -> adapters -> application -> domain`; do not add Dallas or source-format vocabulary to application or domain contracts. [source_id: c83b55e968e3981f0030935d] [source_id: 76e21fb4c68b6f87724edaac]
Production readiness: successful parser tests alone must not mark the Dallas adapter `production_ready`. [source_id: 05e1317dff1c2a0b0cdc4827] [source_id: 7676ed46a8bb877ba7fdaac0]
non_goals: Live Dallas discovery, probing, download, archive acquisition, or any network access. [source_id: ca0df171cabe5f246f2a4fe5]

Assigning `TOT_VAL` or another unresolved Dallas fact a canonical market, appraised, assessed, taxable, bill, payment, delinquency, penalty, or interest meaning. [source_id: a8d0164e015d086c00140812] [source_id: b34baeeecb2d6f95937ce5a1]
